title: Satwik-Chirag Eye China Masters Final Spot, Face Malaysian Pair in Semis
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwik-Chirag, are competing for a place in the China Masters final, a significant international event.
summary: India's star men's doubles duo, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, are set to clash with Malaysia's Nur Mohd. Azriyn Ayub Azriyn and Tan Wee Kiong in the semifinals of the China Masters 2026. Fans can check live streaming details and match timings.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards for Indian badminton players across the country, fostering future talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has scheduled an advanced Level-1 coaches course at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Changed for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This update directly impacts the composition of India's women's doubles contingent for the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair for the upcoming selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's promising young talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Releases Player Eligibility for World Junior Championships Final Trials
indian_angle: This notification outlines the players eligible and qualified for the final trials to represent India at the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the list of eligible players and those qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to take place in Cairo, Egypt.
